collection.title: Ford Transit Connect 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Transit Connect 2013 Onwards requires a 30" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Ford Transit Connect 2013 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
